sn17.26:1.1: assādañca ādīnavañcanissaraṇañca yāthābhūtaṃ napajānanti || || Evam kātabbam || || Ye ca kho keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā lābhasakkārasilokassa samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam pajānanti || sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti || || Chaṭṭhaṃ || ||
